info.name: OS Management Hub Reporting Managed Instance API
Returns user specified metrics for a collection of managed instances which match the given filters.

params.name: metricNames
params.description: A filter to return only metrics whose name matches the given metric names.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description:
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment. 
This filter returns only resources contained within the specified compartment.

params.name: compartmentIdInSubtree
params.description: Indicates whether to include subcompartments in the returned results. Default is false.

params.name: managedInstanceGroupId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance group. This filter returns resources associated with this group.

params.name: dynamicSetId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the dynamic set. This filter returns resources associated with this dynamic set.

params.name: lifecycleEnvironmentId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the lifecycle environment. This filter returns only resource contained with the specified lifecycle environment.

params.name: lifecycleStageId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the lifecycle stage. This resource returns resources associated with this lifecycle stage.

params.name: status
params.description: A filter to return only managed instances whose status matches the status provided.

params.name: location
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose location matches the given value.

params.name: locationNotEqualTo
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose location does not match the given value.

params.name: osFamily
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given operating system family.

params.name: isManagedByAutonomousLinux
params.description: Indicates whether to list only resources managed by the Autonomous Linux service.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return resources that match the given display names.

params.name: displayNameContains
params.description: A filter to return resources that may partially match the given display name.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `3`

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. The default is to sort in ascending order by metricName (previously name, which is now depricated). 
You can also sort by displayName (default is ascending order).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

items.docs: Returns a list of user specified metrics for a collection of managed instances.

info.name: Download a user selected format (CSV/XML/JSON) vulnerability report of a single managed instances

params.name: managedInstanceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the managed instance.

params.name: advisoryName
params.description:
The assigned erratum name. It's unique and not changeable.

Example: `ELSA-2020-5804`

params.name: advisoryNameContains
params.description: A filter to return resources that may partially match the erratum advisory name given.

params.name: advisoryType
params.description: A filter to return only errata that match the given advisory types.

params.name: vulnerabilityName
params.description: A filter to return vulnerabilities that match the given name. For Linux instances, this refers to the advisory name. For Windows instances, this refers to the Windows update display name.

params.name: vulnerabilityNameContains
params.description: A filter to return vulnerabilities that partially match the given name. For Linux instances, this refers to the advisory name. For Windows instances, this refers to the Windows update display name.

params.name: vulnerabilityType
params.description: A filter to return only vulnerabilities matching the given types.

params.name: reportFormat
params.description: The format of the report to download. Default is CSV.

items.docs: Returns a report for a single managed instance whose associated erratas match the given filters. You can select CSV, XML, or JSON format.
